Office and IT equipment delivery for remote teams

New hire starting Monday? Laptop needs to come back from someone who left? We deliver and pick up office equipment for remote workers and branch offices, with live tracking and a signature at every handoff.

Get your instant price Send us a message

Delivery and pickup, door to door

We take laptops, monitors, docking stations, printers, phones, chairs and other office equipment from your office, IT vendor or repair shop to an employee's home or a branch office, and bring equipment back the same way.

Onboarding, swaps and returns

IT teams, office managers and HR use us to get a new hire set up on day one, swap out a broken laptop the same day, collect equipment when someone leaves, and move gear between offices. You can book several stops on one order.

Signed for at every handoff

Every delivery and pickup is confirmed with a signature, a photo, the time and the GPS location, so you have a record of who received what and when. Add serial or asset tag numbers to the instructions for the driver for your records.

Handled with care

Equipment rides in the vehicle with the driver, not in a sorting warehouse with other packages. Pack it in its box or a padded case, and no single piece over 75 lbs. Large copiers and anything needing a liftgate are outside what we carry.

How it works

  1. 1. Get your price

    Enter the pickup and delivery addresses for an instant quote. No calling around.

  2. 2. Book in minutes

    Choose standard or Rush and a car, minivan or pickup truck, then pay securely online.

  3. 3. Track it live

    Follow the driver on the map. Delivery is confirmed with a photo, signature and GPS location.

Questions

Can you pick up a laptop from an employee who's leaving?

Yes. Book the employee's address as the pickup and your office as the drop-off. We'll collect it and confirm the handoff with a photo and signature.

Can you deliver outside Columbia?

Yes. We deliver anywhere in South Carolina, plus nearby North Carolina and Georgia, so remote employees around the state can get equipment the same day.

Can we be invoiced monthly?

Approved business accounts can be invoiced instead of paying by card for each delivery. Send us a message to set it up.
